ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, all borders, every hairline divider, filled language toggle — the entire structural skeleton of the page

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, pill interiors, button text on dark fills

blush-bloom.$description: Blush Bloom — Brand mark fill (the ANA CUNA pill in the header) and the sole chromatic accent — a whisper of warmth that marks identity without ever shouting

abcmonumentgrotesk-regular.$description: Sole typeface for the entire system. One weight — regular — is used at all three sizes: 94px for project titles (display), 31px for secondary headings, 15px for body, nav, tags, and footer. The refusal to introduce a bold or italic weight is a signature editorial choice; hierarchy comes purely from size, not weight.
